description:
About Moloco:

Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.

Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. Moloco Ads is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. Moloco Commerce Media enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.

Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.

Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!

We are currently hiring interns for our Winter Internship Program, with positions targeted for the upcoming winter break.

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

  • Moloco seeks exceptional Software Engineers to join us in building a state-of-the-art mobile advertising platform. You will be building world-class infrastructure which combines machine learning and big data to help companies supercharge their growth. Many leading service owners and marketers worldwide already benefit from Moloco’s innovative technology to scale performance quickly and efficiently through battle tested prediction models.
    As a company founded by Software Engineers, we understand the value of a strong engineering team and strive to hire only the best talent. You will be challenged to solve real-world problems with top-notch colleagues. Check out our case study published by Google https://cloud.google.com/customers/moloco/.

The Opportunity:

  • Write server-side code that handles millions of requests per second.
  • Implement advertising functionality and customer-facing features.
  • Learn and explore technologies to improve the services.
  • Collaborate with internal/external cross-functional teams to make the best advertising products.

How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?

  • Pursuing BS/MS/PhD degree in computer science or related majors.
  • Outstanding problem solving skills with proper data structures and algorithms.
  • Excellent software development skills at least in one programming language
  • Major/minor in Mathematics or relevant coursework/experience is a plus

Preferred Skills

  • Expected to graduate within a year, OR already graduated within a year
  • Fluent in English and Korean (both verbal and written)

** Work-from-home is not available for this role

Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being: 

We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.

Moloco Values: 

  • Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success. 
  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible. 
  • Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value. 
  • Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail. 

Additional Resources: 

  • Moloco Company Blog 
  • Moloco Leadership
  • Moloco Newsroom

Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. description:
About Moment Energy

Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it.

Energy should be free.  Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone.

The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy.

Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact.

We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale.

Now is the moment. Join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineering Co-op to join our Engineering team, starting in January 2027. In this role, you will support the design, development, and testing of our battery energy storage systems while gaining hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers.

You will contribute to mechanical design, fabrication, testing, and documentation while helping bring new products from concept through prototype and testing. This is a great opportunity for a student who enjoys hands-on work and wants to apply mechanical engineering principles to real-world clean energy technology.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Support the mechanical design and integration of battery energy storage systems
  • Use 3D CAD software to create models and develop detailed mechanical drawings
  • Contribute to the research, development, and improvement of mechanical subsystems
  • Assist with hands-on fabrication and assembly of enclosures and subsystems
  • Perform basic mechanical and electrical assembly tasks including installing fasteners, connectors, and wiring harnesses
  • Assist in mechanical and system-level testing and document results
  • Produce design documentation, test documentation, and FMEA documentation
  • Support mechanical builds, prototype testing, and troubleshooting during development
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure products are reliable, manufacturable, and ready for production

The Student we’re looking for:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
  • Strong preference for students with design team or previous co-op experience
  • Strong preference for students available for an 8-month co-op term
  • Experience with 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar)
  • Career interest in mechanical design, prototyping, and product development
  • Hands-on experience with fabrication, assembly, or prototyping (school projects, labs, or personal projects are acceptable)
  • Understanding of mechanical drawings, tolerancing, and engineering documentation
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Detail-oriented with good documentation and communication skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment

The Experience You’ll Gain:

  • Hands-on experience developing real subsystems used in energy storage systems
  • Mentorship from experienced professional mechanical engineers
  • Exposure to product development, prototyping, and testing
  • The opportunity to contribute to technology supporting the clean energy transition

Why join us?

  • Today, we’re delivering 5x the energy density and have all the certifications needed to ship energy independence to the world.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company focused on creating sustainable energy solutions and making a positive impact on the world.
  • Collaborate closely with passionate co-founders and a team committed to innovation and excellence.
  • Contribute to building and scaling a company from the ground up, where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact.
  • Thrive in a workplace that values collaboration, wellness, and celebrating successes, with regular company socials, fitness sessions, and more.

 

We're a fast-paced and dynamic team.

Every day you'll be taking on a new challenge and learning something new. You'll take on a wide breadth of tasks and contribute to disrupting the battery industry. You'll be part of a tight-knit team that is working together to save the planet! Fun, health, and wellness are incorporated into our daily schedule and we encourage all our team members to bring innovative ideas to the table to create an interactive workplace.

As a Quality Control Intern you will play a key role in supporting the design, development, and manufacturing processes of our spacecraft components. You will work with engineers and quality control experts to implement quality assurance protocols, conduct inspections, and identify areas for process improvement. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in aerospace operations while contributing to the success of groundbreaking space missions.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Inspection and Testing: Assist in the inspection and testing of spacecraft components and systems to ensure they meet stringent quality and performance standards.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Support the creation and maintenance of quality control documentation, including inspection records, test reports, and non-conformance reports.
  • Process Improvement: Analyze manufacturing and assembly processes to identify areas where quality can be improved and help implement corrective actions.

QuEra Computing is building the world’s most powerful neutral-atom quantum computers. Our systems are designed to scale and enable groundbreaking advances in science and technology. We collaborate closely with leading academic and industry partners to push the boundaries of quantum computing, error correction, and fault tolerance.

Description
QuEra Computing Inc. seeks a Quantum Error Correction (QEC) Research Intern to join our growing team of scientists and engineers developing hardware-efficient and scalable quantum error correction schemes. As an intern, you will work alongside experts in theoretical and experimental quantum information to help design, simulate, and analyze error correction strategies for our neutral-atom quantum computing platform. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of theory and hardware, contributing directly to the development of large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation.

Possible internship projects include development of novel logical gate schemes with low overhead, improved decoding methods, and implementation of QEC protocols on state-of-the-art quantum hardware.   • Strong programming skills and experience with numerical simulation tools (e.g., Stim, decoders, or other custom code)

description:
About QuEra Computing, Inc.

QuEra Computing is building the world’s most powerful neutral-atom quantum computers. Our systems are designed to scale and enable groundbreaking advances in science and technology. We collaborate closely with leading academic and industry partners to push the boundaries of quantum computing, error correction, and fault tolerance.

Summary

 

QuEra Computing Inc. seeks creative and collaborative Scientific Software Interns to help advance the software that connects high-level quantum applications to neutral-atom quantum computers. Working with software engineers, experimental and computational physicists, and a community of industry and academic collaborators, you will contribute to research and engineering at the intersection of programming languages, compilers, and quantum computing.

We offer a range of research and engineering projects, from investigating new compilation methods and developing prototypes to building software infrastructure and integrating with quantum hardware. Projects span quantum circuits, atom movement, and pulse-level control. Each intern will work with a mentor on a project matched to their interests, experience, and team priorities.

Our compiler stack is evolving from Python toward Rust, creating opportunities to contribute to existing tools, including our open-source compiler framework Kirin, as well as new infrastructure. Depending on the project, your contributions may include algorithms, research findings, benchmarks, or tested and documented software that supports the next generation of neutral-atom quantum computing.  Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and those received before Nov. 15, 2026 are guaranteed full consideration. Internship terms are flexible, including outside the summer, and can be arranged around candidates’ availability.

Responsibilities

 

Responsibilities will vary by project and may include:

  • Investigate research questions in quantum compilation, programming languages, or scientific software; develop prototypes and evaluate approaches through experiments and benchmarks
  • Develop domain-specific languages, intermediate representations, compiler analyses, and transformations for quantum circuits, atom movement, or pulse-level control
  • Build and improve compiler infrastructure in Rust or Python, and support integration with quantum hardware platforms
  • Collaborate with your mentor, software engineers, and physicists to define project goals, discuss technical approaches, and communicate results
  • Contribute tests, documentation, and reproducible examples or experiments appropriate to your project

 

Qualifications

 

  • Experience programming in Python, Rust, or another relevant language, and willingness to learn the tools needed for your project
  • A foundation in computer science or computational methods, demonstrated through coursework, research, personal projects, or other relevant experience
  • Interest in research, software engineering, or both, applied to compilers and scientific software for quantum computing
  • Ability to approach technical problems systematically and communicate ideas, questions, and results clearly
  • Enthusiasm for collaborative work and for building tools used by researchers and developers

Preferred Qualifications

 

The following backgrounds are relevant to different projects; applicants are not expected to have experience in all of them:

  • Academic training or research in computer science, physics, applied mathematics, or a related field
  • Experience with compiler development, intermediate representations such as Static Single Assignment (SSA), program analysis, or optimization
  • Knowledge of programming language design, type systems, or programming language theory
  • Experience with Rust, systems programming, or Python-based scientific software
  • Experience designing experiments, evaluating algorithms, or developing reproducible benchmarks
  • Familiarity with quantum computing, quantum error correction, or atomic, molecular, and optical (AMO) physics
  • Experience with version control, code review, testing, debugging, profiling, or contributions to open-source projects

 

Why Join QuEra?

You will be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team at the forefront of quantum technology. This internship offers exposure to both cutting-edge theory and practical implementation, with opportunities to contribute to peer-reviewed research and real-world quantum hardware development.

On-site internship. There is no relocation offered for this role.

About Re:Build 

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. 

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. 

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles) 

About Re:Build Optimation

At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.

As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.

At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a motivated Construction Management student who wants hands-on experience supporting real-world construction, installation, and manufacturing projects. You’ll work alongside Project and Construction Managers, engineers, skilled trades, subcontractors, and vendors while gaining exposure to projects from early-stage pilots through installation and commissioning.

You are organized, curious, and comfortable learning in both field and shop environments. You communicate clearly, take initiative, and are willing to ask questions while building your understanding of project execution, safety, quality, scheduling, and cost management.

This co-op/internship is a strong fit if you want practical experience that builds a foundation for a future career in project or construction management.

What You Get To Do

  • Support Project and Construction Managers with the day-to-day execution of field installation and shop fabrication projects.
  • Track project schedules, milestones, budgets, and deliverables, identifying potential delays or issues for the project team.
  • Participate in site walk-throughs and inspections to observe project progress, quality, and safety conditions.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors on schedules, deliverables, and follow-up items.
  • Document project progress through site photos, status reports, meeting notes, and punch lists.
  • Maintain punch lists and help track outstanding items through completion and project closeout.
  • Support safety and quality activities on client job sites, identifying and escalating concerns when appropriate.
  • Assist with commissioning activities as systems transition from installation to operational status.
  • Collaborate with engineers, skilled trades, and field personnel to gain exposure to the full project lifecycle.
  • Maintain organized project records, including reports, photos, correspondence, and other documentation.
  • Follow Re and client safety requirements, including PPE and site-specific procedures, while working in field and shop environments.

What You Bring To The Team

  • Currently enrolled in a Construction Management or related college program.
  • Some familiarity with project scheduling or construction management software, such as MS Project or Procore, and CAD tools.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic understanding of construction and workplace safety practices; OSHA awareness is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project teams, engineers, and skilled trades.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

  • This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days per week in our San Francisco, CA headquarter office and 2 days working remotely.  Relocation and housing assistance will be included as part of the co-op. 

About this role:

Samsara’s cloud-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery-powered, wireless sensors, linux-based IoT gateways, and Internet-connected dashcams. description:
Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

 

ABOUT THE FIRM

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations team

Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by Who's Who Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters.

  • Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputes
  • Analyze financial statements, business records, market data, and other evidence to help quantify damages and support valuation work
  • Build models, organize data, and develop analyses that help explain financial issues clearly and accurately
  • Contribute to reports, presentations, and client-ready materials that turn detailed analysis into compelling insights
  • Work closely with senior consultants and experts, gaining hands-on experience in litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, and economic consulting

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving puzzles, working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how financial analysis can make a real impact in business and legal settings. The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another analytically rigorous discipline from an accredited college or university
  • Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new concepts and ask thoughtful questions
  • Interest or experience in economic consulting, litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, finance, accounting, data analysis, or other research-intensive work
  • Experience with research projects, undergraduate theses, consulting internships, data analytics internships, finance-related work, or similar experiences that demonstrate ownership of complex work
  • Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, or SQL is helpful, along with an eagerness to continue building technical skills
  • Comfort working with data, conducting research, organizing information clearly, and using emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality, and analytical rigor
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to balance multiple assignments and communicate proactively
  • Ability to stay focused, adaptable, and solutions-oriented when priorities shift or deadlines are tight
  • Clear listening, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a thoughtful and professional way; fluency in English for business communication is required
  • Interest in professional development or credentials such as CPA, CFA, C

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
  • Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
  • Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
  • Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
  • Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak cand

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Fraud Operations intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Shopper Risk Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Interns will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time during the days and hours listed below:

  • Monday - Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time.

This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

  • Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Fraud Operations Intern is $800 USD gross monthly.

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

  • Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.
  • Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

  • Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.
  • Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.
  • Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.
  • Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes
  • Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time
  • A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation
  • Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend clearly for a non-technical audience
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to operations, product, fintech, data analysis, trust & safety, or startups is a plus. We hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

  • Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.
  • Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

  • Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.
  • Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.
  • Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.
  • Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes
  • Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time
  • A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation
  • Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend clearly for a non-technical audience
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to operations, product, fintech, data analysis, trust & safety, or startups is a plus. We hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

  • French is mandatory at a fluent level and you can communicate clearly in English.

🤸‍♀️Flexibility, autonomy and adaptability are part of our core values: we are a horizontal organization without bureaucracy (40% of staff are data scientists) but optimal and reduced line management, focus on delivery and development while having a hybrid model.

🧠Learn from inside an AI leader tech company: join the 13th French Unicorn providing hands on training, workshop and sessions with highly experienced AI research Team.  

💶Your commitment, our investment: 2000€ gross monthly gratification, high  conversion rate to full time employee, dedicated HR partner, regular reviews and feedback sessions with your team.

🌍Be part of an international and diverse tech firm: full english speaking environment with 55 different nationalities across the world and 11 offices locations (Paris, Singapore, Tokyo, Sao Paulo, Mexico City, Boston, Madrid, London, Toronto, ...)

🤝Dealing with big clients and developing business skills & knowledge: real life experience with insurance business challenges inside the world of AI.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the team

The APAC Payments TechOps team ensures the accuracy of financial data flowing through Stripe's payment infrastructure, manages aging balances, maintains compliance with partner and regulatory requirements, and builds tooling to detect and resolve data quality issues at scale. Through the internship, you will work with real financial data, gain experience in payments data analysis and operational problem-solving, and have opportunities to present your work to your team and the wider org. Each intern has a dedicated intern manager, and every project is part of the team's roadmap and will directly help Stripe's mission.

What you’ll do

Every internship at Stripe centers around a real, legitimate project that our team urgently needs. We will support you in shipping it. Yes, you will actually ship it. Example projects include building data quality checks for payment flows, creating dashboards to surface aging balance trends, automating compliance reporting, or analyzing cost structures across partner networks. As a Stripe intern, you'll be tackling important projects while working alongside exceptional people who insist on doing their best work. You'll learn from people with high standards who are great at inspiring others to do more and go further. We value technical and personal growth, and see our internship program as a vehicle to foster both.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze financial data by writing queries and examining data quality, reconciliation accuracy, or cost structures across Stripe's payment flows
  • Write code or build tooling that will be used in production and has meaningful impact to Stripe's payment operations
  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews, data model discussions, or analysis walkthroughs
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and finance stakeholders to seek and incorporate feedback on your work
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, by working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, and by communicating the status of your work clearly

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of quantitative analysis through pursuit of a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, data science, finance, economics, information systems, or a related discipline
  • Some experience and familiarity with programming or data analysis, either through side projects or coursework. We work mostly in SQL, Python, and Ruby. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present
  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders

As an Apprentice Technician, you will support spacecraft production, mechanical assembly, integration, and testing while developing the skills needed to become a well- rounded spacecraft technician. This entry-level role is designed for individuals with limited
industry experience who are eager to learn through hands-on training, mentorship, and cross-functional exposure.

Mechanical Assembly and Integration: Support the assembly and integration of spacecraft structures, components, mechanisms, panels, brackets, fasteners, and flight
hardware. Assist with the installation and removal of components under the guidance of experienced technicians.

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• 0–1 year of manufacturing, mechanical, technical, automotive, aerospace, aviation,
electronics, or similar hands-on experience.
• Basic mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn.
• Comfort working with hand tools, power tools, and measuring equipment.
• Ability to follow detailed written and verbal instructions.

• Reliable, team-oriented, and willing to take on new responsibilities.

We are hiring a summer cybersecurity intern to help our Information security team with day to day work. You will help us watch for security alerts, write things down clearly, and gather the paperwork we need for our upcoming cybersecurity certification.

This is a real job, not busywork. You will look at real alerts, write real reports, and help us get ready for a real audit. You will sit with our Cybersecurity Analyst and our InfoSec Engineer, and you will learn how a security team works inside a company.

Responsibilities

  • Help review security alerts that come in each day. You will read them, decide what they are, and write down what you did about them.
  • Help set up, fine tune, and improve the way our security tools are configured. These tools include Zscaler, CrowdStrike, ThreatLocker, Darktrace, and AlienVault. You will work with your lead to adjust settings, clean up noisy alerts, and make sure each tool is doing its job well.
  • Help keep our security event logs up to date, so we have a clear record of what happened and how it was handled.
  • Pull sample logs from our security tools and organize them, so we can show an auditor that we are watching the right things.
  • Help keep track of the reports we get from our outside security partner, making sure they arrive on time and get filed in the right place.
  • Help upload reports and updates into the software we use to track our compliance work.
  • Work on one bigger summer project that you own from start to finish. You will pick this with your lead in the first week. Some examples: a report on gaps in our logging, a refreshed incident response guide, or a simple dashboard.

What You Will Learn

  • How a information security team runs its day to day work when the company has to pass a security audit.
  • How the things we do every day (looking at alerts, writing things down, storing logs) turn into the proof an auditor wants to see.
  • Hands on use of real security tools that protect computers, networks, web traffic, software, and user accounts. You will get real practice setting up and improving tools like Zscaler, CrowdStrike, ThreatLocker, Darktrace, and AlienVault.
  • How to write clearly about technical problems so that people who are not technical can still understand you.
  • How the different people on a information security team work together: the InfoSec Head, the analyst, the engineer, the compliance manager, and our outside security partners.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a current undergrad in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, information systems, or a similar major. 
  • You have taken classes or taught yourself at least two of these: networking, how operating systems work, how user accounts and passwords are managed, how to respond to security incidents, or how to watch for security problems.
  • You are comfortable reading logs and working with data in a spreadsheet. You know what a basic script is, even if you have not written many.
  • You write clearly. You will be writing notes and reports that other people rely on.
  • You are organized, you pay attention to details, and you are willing to ask questions when something is unclear.
  • You are allowed to work in the United States for the full length of the internship without needing us to sponsor a visa.

Nice to Have 

  • You are working toward a beginner certification like CompTIA Security Plus or Network Plus.
  • You have played with security tools on your own, in a home lab, in a school club, or in a capture the flag competition.

The Biologics Formulation Research Internship focuses on the analytical characterization and formulation of biologic drug candidates to support the development of stable pharmaceutical products for manufacturing in microgravity. Interns will apply a variety of biophysical and analytical techniques to evaluate protein structure, stability, binding interactions, and performance through formulation and freeze-drying processes. The role combines hands-on laboratory experimentation, scientific data analysis, and close collaboration with formulation scientists to advance next-generation biologic therapeutics.

Internships at Varda are optimal for students looking to grow technically and professionally while working on impactful projects critical to the company's success. You will be working on a collaborative team in a startup environment while being able to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the world. We're dedicated to providing an experience that will let your decisions and contributions help drive Varda's success.

Responsibilities

  • Perform biophysical characterization of protein candidates using orthogonal analytical techniques to assess structure, stability, and interaction behavior

  • Design and execute binding and selection studies between disordered protein stabilizers and microcrystalline pharmaceutical substrates
  • Evaluate stabilizer performance through lyophilization and reconstitution cycles, assessing protein integrity before and after freeze-drying stress
  • Conduct purity and charge variant analysis via SDS-PAGE and capillary isoelectric focusing (cIEF)
  • Prepare reagents, buffers, and sample sets in advance to ensure experiments run on schedule
  • Maintain accurate, well-documented records in laboratory notebooks and electronic systems
  • Collaborate with formulation scientists to anticipate laboratory needs and contribute to team meetings and progress updates

Key Techniques & Methods

Interns will gain hands-on experience with industry-standard biophysical and analytical tools, including:

  • Nano differential scanning fluorimetry (nanoDSF)
  • Analytical size exclusion chromatography (SEC)
  • Dynamic light scattering (DLS)
  • Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy
  • UV spectroscopy
  • Fluorescence spectroscopy
  • SDS-PAGE and capillary isoelectric focusing (cIEF)
  • Selection and binding studies
  • General familiarity with lyophilization and tangential flow filtration (TFF) as they relate to sample preparation and handling

What You'll Learn

  • How to characterize protein and peptide structure, stability, and molecular interactions using multiple orthogonal biophysical techniques
  • How to design and interpret binding and interaction studies between disordered proteins/peptides and crystalline substrates
  • How biophysical characterization connects to formulation strategy and long-term storage stability for biologic drugs
  • Best practices in analytical method execution, data interpretation, and scientific documentation in a biotech R&D environment

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor's or graduate degree program in Biochemistry, Biophysics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Molecular Biology, or a related field
  • Prior hands-on laboratory experience in an academic or industry setting is required
  • Knowledge of basic analytical techniques for protein characterization
  • Stron

Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As an Expansion Intern, you’ll get a front-row seat to how Via launches and scales new markets around the world. You’ll gain hands-on experience across entrepreneurship, Operations, Product, and Marketing, work on real projects, learn from experienced teammates, and see how different teams come together to bring new ideas to life.

And no two launches look the same. One week, you might be helping launch an on-demand service alongside electric buses; the next, supporting a new university shuttle or an entire city transit system. That’s what makes Expansion so exciting: you’ll get to see the many different ways Via is reimagining public transportation.

Based in either Paris or Berlin, you’ll support the launch and growth of our services in Germany while also contributing to expansion projects across Via’s global markets. 

This is a full-time internship (40 hours/week) for 6 months, starting as soon as possible, ideally in October or November. We're also open to working students.

  • Contribute to the project planning required to set up Via-enabled mobility services for new partners
  • Lead testing efforts for our new global launches, providing ongoing support as needed to enable and promote project success
  • Ensure that our engineering team is getting the feedback they need to build the best product possible
  • Tap Via’s in-house product, operational, and marketing knowledge base to help partners get the most out of our technology, while contributing to our scaling growth
  • Work collaboratively with our Berlin team, as well as other Via teammates in Paris, London, Berlin, and New York, to test and implement product improvements

Who You Are: 

  • Entrepreneurial and a proactive problem solver; you don’t accept the status quo and are always looking for creative solutions
  • Effective at managing multiple tasks simultaneously and comfortable taking on responsibility
  • Willing to wear multiple hats and work on projects of all types
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to adjust to a variety of stakeholders
  • Eager and available to travel for field tests when needed
  • Fluency in English and German (C2 or above) is required

What We Offer:

  • Joining a global employer with 1,000+ mobility deployments across 40+ countries
  • Becoming part of a company that was awarded for its commitment to social good:
    • We are one of 17 Ventures That Embody the U.N.’s 17 Sustainability Goals.
    • Inc. Magazine’s “Best in Business” Awardee in the software category for Companies That Put Purpose Before Profit
  • Base salary pay: €15/hour, which amounts to:
    • €2,300 - 2,400 gross per month, based on a 40-hour week
  • If you're based in Paris: Hybrid working and a beautiful office in the heart of Paris (Saint-Lazare)

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As an Expansion Intern, you’ll get a front-row seat to how Via launches and scales new markets around the world. You’ll gain hands-on experience across entrepreneurship, Operations, Product, and Marketing, work on real projects, learn from experienced teammates, and see how different teams come together to bring new ideas to life.

And no two launches look the same. One week, you might be helping launch an on-demand service alongside electric buses; the next, supporting a new university shuttle or an entire city transit system. That’s what makes Expansion so exciting: you’ll get to see the many different ways Via is reimagining public transportation.

Based in either Paris or Berlin, you’ll support the launch and growth of our services in Germany while also contributing to expansion projects across Via’s global markets. 

This is a full-time internship (40 hours/week) for 6 months, starting as soon as possible, ideally in October or November. We're also open to working students. 

What You'll Do:

  • Contribute to the project planning required to set up Via-enabled mobility services for new partners
  • Lead testing efforts for our new global launches, providing ongoing support as needed to enable and promote project success
  • Ensure that our engineering team is getting the feedback they need to build the best product possible
  • Tap Via’s in-house product, operational, and marketing knowledge base to help partners get the most out of our technology, while contributing to our scaling growth
  • Work collaboratively with our Berlin team, as well as other Via teammates in Paris, London, Berlin, and New York, to test and implement product improvements

Who You Are: 

  • Entrepreneurial and a proactive problem solver; you don’t accept the status quo and are always looking for creative solutions
  • Effective at managing multiple tasks simultaneously and comfortable taking on responsibility
  • Willing to wear multiple hats and work on projects of all types
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to adjust to a variety of stakeholders
  • Eager and available to travel for field tests when needed
  • Fluency in English and German (C2 or above) is required

What We Offer:

  • Joining a global employer with 1,000+ mobility deployments across 40+ countries
  • Becoming part of a company that was awarded for its commitment to social good:
    • We are one of 17 Ventures That Embody the U.N.’s 17 Sustainability Goals.
    • Inc. Magazine’s “Best in Business” Awardee in the software category for Companies That Put Purpose Before Profit
  • Base salary pay: €15/hour, which amounts to:
    • €2,300 - 2,400 gross per month, based on a 40-hour week
  • If you're based in Berlin: a lovely office situated in the heart of Berlin, at Chausseestraße and weekly team lunch and breakfast.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Summary:

We are seeking highly motivated emerging talent to participate in a 10-week immersive internship program from June 7, 2027, to August 13, 2027. This program offers university students hands-on experience through project-based work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Throughout the program, Interns will have exposure to mentorship, networking, and professional development opportunities.

The Electrical Engineering intern will support Voyager Technologies at one of the following locations:

  • San Diego, CA
  • Houston, TX
  • Long Beach, CA
  • Pittsburgh, PA

The Electrical Engineering Intern will support the engineering team with a variety of activities related to electrical design, development, testing, documentation, and engineering support. This internship provides an opportunity to apply foundational electrical engineering knowledge to real-world projects while working alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.

The intern may contribute to projects involving electrical design, component selection, circuit development, engineering documentation, testing, troubleshooting, or other electrical engineering activities based on current business and engineering priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with electrical engineering design, development, and analysis activities for assigned projects.
  • Support the creation, review, and maintenance of electrical schematics, drawings, models, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Assist with creating, updating, and maintaining engineering parts, components, libraries, and technical databases.
  • Support mid-level and senior engineers with project-related engineering tasks and deliverables.
  • Assist with component research, selection, and documentation as appropriate.
  • Participate in electrical testing, troubleshooting, and evaluation activities as appropriate.
  • Support the collection, organization, and analysis of engineering data and test results.
  • Assist with documenting technical information, design decisions, processes, and test activities.
  • Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, systems, software, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams as needed.
  • Participate in engineering reviews, team meetings, training sessions, and other learning opportunities.
  • Contribute ideas for process improvement, engineering efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
  • Complete assigned projects and deliverables accurately and within established timelines.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program at an accredited university, preferably pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated understanding of fundamental electrical engineering principles and concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to learn and apply new engineering tools, processes, and methodologies.
  • Familiarity with electrical engineering design, simulation, or documentation tools preferred.
  • Ability to travel for in-person orientation and program kickoff, as well as for the final presentation at program completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous internship, coursework, academic project, laboratory experience, or other relevant experience related to electrical engineering.
  • Experience with circuit design, schematic capture, PCB design, electrical testing, or troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with electrical engineering software or tools such as Altium, MATLAB, LTspice, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with engineering drawings, component libraries, bills of materials, or technical documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, test equipment, prototyping, or electronics development.
  • Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering projects or cross-functional development environments.

Hourly Pay Range: $27.00 - $37.00 per hour

Position: Special Projects Developer Intern (Summer 2027)

Location: New York, NY

Firm Overview:

Walleye Capital is a ~$17 billion+ multi-strategy investment firm headquartered in New York City, with over 350 employees across five main offices. Founded in 2005 as an options market maker, we have organically grown into a global investment firm specializing in Fundamental Equities, Quant, and Volatility strategies. 

At Walleye, we continuously innovate by focusing on three core principles: approach, platform, and people. Our approach is to allocate risk capital where we believe there is not only a compelling opportunity, but also a clear ability to define our tangible edge. We seek to leverage the mathematical benefits of diversification while utilizing sophisticated infrastructure, technology, and our balance sheet to do so in a structurally advantageous way. Our platform, developed over two decades, is central to our operations, evolving alongside business complexities and technological advancements to support our team’s success. Our people are our greatest asset, and we’ve cultivated an environment that attracts top talent by balancing autonomy with collaboration, and intelligence with integrity.

Position Overview:

Walleye Capital is seeking Special Projects Developer Interns for Summer 2027. In this role, you’ll work alongside a dynamic team and partner with senior leadership to advance high-impact strategic initiatives that fall outside of the core operations of the hedge fund. You’ll help translate business needs and prototypes into practical, technology-enabled solutions, including building internal AI-native tools, custom agents that streamline workflows, and management-facing reporting that improves business visibility. This internship offers meaningful hands-on development experience, exposure to high-priority projects, and direct mentorship.

The internship is 10 weeks in length and will take place in New York City from June to August 2027.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the team in translating high-level strategic objectives into structured project plans and executable workflows.
  • Contribute to greenfield projects throughout the development lifecycle, including research, scoping, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
  • Build and enhance internal AI-native tools, user-facing applications, automations, and processes.
  • Act as an internal technological consultant/liaison to teams across the firm to understand business needs, gather domain expertise, and help advance cross-functional initiatives.
  • Potential to contribute to executive-facing technology solutions.

We seek individuals who:

  • Are pursuing an undergraduate or non-MBA master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
  • Showcase excellent communication and problem-solving skills, an ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical audiences, intellectual curiosity, and comfort working through ambiguous problems.
  • Are a proactive self-starter with demonstrated leadership ability, strong ownership mentality, and the initiative to move projects forward independently.
  • Demonstrate exceptional quantitative and analytical skills, with a strong foundation in programming (specifically Python) and a passion for technological innovation; familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL databases and API development is a plus.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, drive efficiency, and improve workflows; hold experience integrating AI services, including LLMs or APIs, into academic, research, internship, or personal projects.
  • Have a genuine interest in the hedge fund industry and how high-performing organizations operate, with previous internship, research, or project experience in financial services, technology, or another fast-paced environment.
