description:
About Wheely

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Wheely runs a high-frequency, luxury marketplace — precision isn't a goal here, it's the baseline. As an Operations Intern in Paris, you'll work inside the France Operations team across the full chauffeur lifecycle: acquisition, retention, and day-to-day chauffeur management. This is a flexible internship (3 to 6 months, depending on your need) available immediately or in the coming weeks (starting no later than January 2027).

This isn't a coffee-and-slides internship. You'll carry real workstreams, with real stakes, from week one.

Why This Role

  • High-growth business. Wheely France is scaling fast and expanding into new markets.
  • Direct impact. Your analysis feeds decisions across acquisition, retention, and chauffeur quality — not a slide deck that sits in a folder.
  • Real exposure. You'll work directly with the Ops team and senior leadership on live problems, with room to bring your own ideas.

Responsibilities

  • Support chauffeur acquisition, retention, and day-to-day chauffeur management across the France Operations team.
  • Turn data into clear, actionable insights — root-causing issues, tracking initiatives, and flagging what's working and what isn't.
  • Prepare data pulls, dashboards, and analyses for the wider Ops and leadership team.
  • Act as a day-to-day Wheely representative to the chauffeur community.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a top French grande école, école d'ingénieur, or university (final year or gap year/césure).
  • Comfortable with data and eager to build hands-on skills in SQL (no prior knowledge required, but is a plus).
  • A structured thinker who turns ambiguity into a plan, not a shrug.
  • Clear communicator, able to summarise a complex point simply.
  • Available for 3 to 6 months.
  • Fluent French and English.
  • Based in Paris, ability to work full-time in the office 5 days a week.

What we Offer

  • Office-based role in Paris (9th arrondissement)
  • Convention de stage obligatoire
  • Competitive salary of €1,800/month
  • Best-in-class equipment
  • Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys
  • Daily Lunch Allowance
  • Real ownership on live projects, working directly with the France leadership team

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

 

Role Summary and Impact

We are seeking a curious Intern, Activation Linear Planning to join our dynamic team in Milan. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to gain hands-on experience within a core media planning unit, collaborating on campaigns for our most important clients.   • Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Any knowledge of media research tools (e.g., audience measurement platforms, competitive intelligence software) or ad-serving platforms will be considered a significant plus.

Skills and Behaviors

  • A rapid and eager learner, adept at quickly applying new knowledge and insights to daily tasks and evolving media challenges.

description:
About Wurl, LLC.

At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.

In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

 

About the role:

Wurl is seeking an intern with proven academic achievements in data analytics related fields for a year long internship. Wurl’s position in the video and ad delivery ecosystem generates large quantities of data that needs to be carefully analyzed and normalized. We’re looking for an intern that can become familiar with Wurl’s datasets and their usage and support our Data Science and Machine Learning team. The ideal candidate is a PhD / MSc in the field of DataScience, AI/ML, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform analysis tasks to identify anomalies and their root cause as well as propose and put in place validations to programmatically identify such conditions
  • Propose methods to normalize the data, implement them, check accuracy and iterate until sufficient accuracy is achieved 
  • Increase the accuracy of derived datasets and data products

 

Qualifications:

  • Education - 
    • PhD / MSC preferred. BSc with high gpa, multiple majors, notable projects is also accepted
    • Field: DataScience, AI/ML, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science
  • Technical
    • Graph algorithms and network analysis
    • Large-scale data analysis
    • Data quality and anomaly detection
    • Agentic / AI-assisted software development
    • Familiarity with distributed data platforms such as Snowflake / Databricks
    • Strong Python and SQL
    • Applied statistics and probability
    • Machine learning fundamentals
    • Experiment design and causal reasoning
    • Optimization / decision-making under uncertainty
    • Ability to write clean, maintainable analytical code
    • Non agentic development experience is mandatory
    • Nice to have
  • Modeling / Research
    • Comfortable evaluating models beyond headline metrics
    • Experience moving from research idea → prototype → validated result
    • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into mathematical or statistical formulations
    • Strong intuition for uncertainty, bias, variance, and noisy data
    • Strong quantitative reasoning and mathematical knowledge
    • Nice to have
  • Problem Solving
    • Ability to recognize when results look wrong
    • Comfortable working with incomplete, messy, or contradictory data
    • Advanced analytical problem-solving ability
    • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills
    • Ability to form and test hypotheses quickly
    • Nice to have
  • Personal Attributes
    • High intellectual curiosity
    • Strong ownership and initiative
    • Rapid learner
    • Independent thinker
    • Comfortable challenging assumptions
    • Willingness to continue digging into 'funny' things until they make sense
    • Effective communication skills and team player.

 

What We Offer:

  • Paid internship ($30/hr) with flexible scheduling.
  • Remote-first work culture and support.
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers and product experts.

description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXAI seeks extraordinary students to join us for Spring 2027 software engineering roles. As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. If you’ve demonstrated a commitment to academic success and motivation to apply your knowledge outside of the classroom, you are a great candidate! 

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. This includes Grok, the frontier AI model for everything you need, trained on the world's largest supercluster, and developing Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s degree or graduate program
  • 3+ months of software programming or development experience
  • Software coding experience in one or more of the following: C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • GPA of 3.5 or above 
  • 6+ months experience developing and deploying software that has been used on real-world applications and projects  
  • Strong fundamental knowledge of computer architecture and networks  
  • Experience with software documentation, creating system diagrams, and enumerating software requirements 
  • Strong skills in debugging, performance optimization and unit testing 
  • Strong interpersonal skills (examples: leading a student organization or working successfully in teams) 
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements 
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Able to work full time, onsite for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning in January or March 2027

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Software Engineering Intern/Freshman/Sophomore: $30 USD per hour  
Software Engineering Intern/Junior/Senior: $34 USD per hour
Software Engineering Intern/Completed Bachelor's: $36 USD per hour
Software Engineering Intern/Completed Master's: $38 USD per hour  
Software Engineering Intern/Completed PhD: $40 USD per hour

Your salary will be determined by academic level. Hourly pay is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI. You may also be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs, as well as access to our comprehensive medical coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Your Opportunity: Our Run Perception Team is seeking a master’s graduate intern to work at our Seattle HQ offices. As the Run Perception Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in product research at the leading running brand – Brooks Sports, Inc. Your primary responsibilities will be to assist Run Perception Researchers as they collect information from product testers across the nation to contribute key perceptual information regarding fit, performance, and design. This information is critical for our multi-departmental infrastructure, including Development, Design, and Merchandising, to ensure that performance integrity of our product meets the needs of our end consumers. You will also gain knowledge on how perceptual feedback influences design and development of athletic products at Brooks. With the Run Perception Team being part of our Development team, you will learn how to work closely with the Developers on building product based off insights collected not only from the Run Perception Team, but also from other collaborators across the company. Conduct internal and external perception testing data collections for inline footwear and the sourcing team. Develop loyal, engaging relationships with our product testers and the Brooks community. Assist with the management of Brooks perception testing community social media account on Facebook with timely and accurate responses to participants and the creation of engaging content for the group. You will use your ever-growing analytical skillset as a graduate student to prepare a thoughtful and elevated project.
